method.boundaryAllowance: Modeled crown plus 0.15 m stays inside the parcel.
method.rootSpaceAllowance: Tree centre is at least 1 m from fixed hardscape, furniture and stepping stones; illustrative allowance, not a surveyed nursery root-ball specification.
method.overhang: Screened layouts permit canopy overhang of pool or other hardscape. Trunks must be in soil. No-overhang comparison is separate.
method.observers: 7 named viewpoints and 10 additional occupied/walkable positions; proposed roots and opaque crowns may not engulf an observer.
method.objective: Weighted sampled-ray coverage with a small penalty for the worst named and extra viewpoint. The living-priority comparison weights the four main living/terrace/jacuzzi views more strongly. Bounded search is not a global-optimum proof.
method.verification: Every reported count is rerun through the full analyzeVisibility function and checked against search bitsets.
method.sunlight: Instantaneous direct-sun grid counts, not daily solar hours or irradiance; the same opaque crown assumption also casts shade.
method.caveat: Ideal opaque catalog-sized crowns, not a guarantee of real foliage density, opaque screening from every point, or visible facade area.
